p6_b0.ocr: In the period from 2019 to 2024, air cargo tonnage has exhibited significant growth within the Asia-Pacific region, as evidenced by the data for SF Express. In 2019, air cargo tonnage stood at 1,200,000 metric tons with a growth rate of 5.0% and a market share of 15.0%. The following year, 2020, saw an increase to 1,300,000 metric tons, representing an 8.3% growth rate and a market share of 16.0%.

p6_b1.ocr: The trend continued into 2021 with tonnage reaching 1,400,000 metric tons, reflecting a growth rate of 7.7% and a 17.0% market share. By 2022, air cargo tonnage further expanded to 1,600,000 metric tons, achieving a robust growth rate of 14.3%, thus increasing the market share to 18.5%. In 2023, the tonnage reached 1,800,000 metric tons with a growth rate of 12.5% and a market share of 19.0%.

p6_b3.ocr: The projections for 2024 indicate a continued upward trajectory with expected tonnage of 2,000,000 metric tons, an 11.1% growth rate, and a market share of 20.0%. The average air cargo tonnage over this period is calculated at 1,500,000 metric tons, with an average growth rate of 10.0% and a market share of 17.5%.

p6_b4.ocr: Forecasts predict a further increase to 2,200,000 metric tons in future years, maintaining a 10.0% growth rate and a market share of 22.0%. Cumulatively, the total air cargo tonnage from 2019 to 2024 amounts to 10,600,000 metric tons, with a cumulative growth rate of 10.0% and an average market share of 19.2%.
